title: SN TOOL STUDIO PRO - Official Release v1.1.6 (Smart Auto-Failover Transcribe & Zero-Lag Lip-Sync Pro)
release_notes:
• 🛡️ Smart Auto-Failover Speech Transcribe: Automatic seamless failover to gemini-3.8-transcribe on rate-limits (HTTP 429/500), ensuring batch processing never stops!
• 🔄 Intelligent Auto-Recovery: Automatically detects when the primary transcribe model is restored and smoothly returns to default.
• 👄 Zero-Lag Lip-Sync Alignment: Synchronized Khmer dubbing directly to visual mouth opening with 130ms ADR anticipation lead - zero delay!
• ⚡ Instant Audio Onset (-44dBFS Silence Trimming): Strips leading dead silence from TTS audio, starting character speech on the exact millisecond!
• 🎯 Multi-Character Dialogue Pre-Segmentation: Intelligently separates conversational drama exchanges and long lines (>3.5s) into natural timed dialogue segments!
• 🚫 Zero Cumulative Drift Lag: Speech start timestamps are anchored permanently, preventing voices from drifting later in long episodes!
• ⏩ Adaptive Dynamic Time-Stretch (up to 1.45x): Speed auto-adjusts seamlessly so characters never continue speaking after closing their mouth!
• 🧠 Drama Idiom & Particle Splitting: Perfectly splits drama dialogues containing modal particles (呀呢吧吗啦啊) and short drama shouts!
